title: Come, Thou Fount of Ev'ry Blessing

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, thou fount of ev'ry blessing
Tune my heart to sing Thy grace
Streams of mercy, never ceasing

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Call for songs of loudest praise
Teach me some melodious sonnet
Sung by flaming tongues above

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise the mount, I'm fixed upon it
Mount of Thy redeeming love

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Hitherto, Thy love has blessed me
Thou hast drawn me to this place
And I know Thy hand will lead me

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Safely home by Thy good grace
Jesus sought me when a stranger
Wandering from the fold of God

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: He, to rescue me from danger
Bought me with His precious blood

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: O to grace how great a debtor
Daily I'm constrained to be
Let thy goodness, like a fetter
Bind my wand'ring heart to thee

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Prone to wander, Lord, I feel it
Prone to leave the God I love

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Here's my heart, O take and seal it
Seal it for thy courts above
